subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A new food label showed not only calories, but also sugar, salt, allergens, and origin.”?
options: A student with allergies said clear labels made her feel safer.
One student said online shopping made mistakes easier.
One student said the cracks made it easier to imagine the pot being found, studied, and cared for.
One student said his little sister learned to tie her shoes.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「A student with allergies said clear labels made her feel safer.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「One student said online shopping made mistakes easier.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One student said the cracks made it easier to imagine the pot being found, studied, and cared for.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One student said his little sister learned to tie her shoes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A student with allergies said clear labels made her feel safer.」，答案為「A student with allergies said clear labels made her feel safer.」。
